why.point: Pay moves after proof, not before: the step costs the company about $10k for 90 days, and $75 starts only once signed targets are hit.
$75 is about $156k a year against about $83k now. Nobody pays a $73k gap on a feeling, so the proof sheet comes first.
Targets are logged inputs signed in advance, so there is no bonus formula to argue about each quarter.
Lead with $75 and name the path to it in the same breath; never say 'or else'.
